calculate_nDCG: calculate the normalized discounted cumulative gain between a similarity matrix and relevancy matrix for ranking evaluation
calculate_DCG: calculate the discounted cumulative gain for a similarity matrix using relevancy scores and k counts
calculate_IDCG: calculate the ideal discounted cumulative gain for perfect retrieval using a relevancy matrix and k counts
calculate_k_counts: calculate the k counts mask from a relevancy matrix to determine valid items for DCG calculation
run_nDCG_module: run the nDCG module to verify DCG, IDCG, and nDCG calculations with sample similarity and relevancy matrices
